containers.name: verify-migration
command:
import sqlite3,json,pathlib,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path('/data/archives/ASTRA-pre-0054-20260905')
original=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(root/"pharness.db")+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
changed=sqlite3.connect("file:/data/pharness.db?mode=ro",uri=True)
assert "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256((root/"pharness.db").read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='sha256:1531fb59c582ded308b2cd691d9dca4f5f96b76f1ca9ff02b49692613fe5aa2d'
changed.execute("BEGIN")
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]=="ok"
assert changed.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()==[]
versions=changed.execute("SELECT version,success FROM _sqlx_migrations ORDER BY version").fetchall()
assert len(versions)==54 and versions[-1]==(54,1) and all(v[1]==1 for v in versions)
def quote(s): return '"'+s.replace('"','""')+'"'
def default(v):
 if isinstance(v,bytes): return {"sqlite_blob_hex":v.hex()}
 raise TypeError(type(v).__name__)
def fingerprint(db,table,columns,where=""):
 h=hashlib.sha256(); n=0
 sql="SELECT "+",".join(map(quote,columns))+" FROM "+quote(table)+where+" ORDER BY "+",".join(map(quote,columns))
 for row in db.execute(sql):
  h.update((json.dumps(list(row),sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,default=default)+"\n").encode()); n+=1
 return {"columns":columns,"rows":n,"sha256":h.hexdigest()}
preserved={}
tables=[r[0] for r in original.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name")]
for table in tables:
 columns=[r[1] for r in original.execute("PRAGMA table_info("+quote(table)+")")]
 before=fingerprint(original,table,columns)
 after=fingerprint(changed,table,columns," WHERE version <= 53" if table=="_sqlx_migrations" else "")
 assert before==after,("original data changed",table,before,after)
 preserved[table]=after
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE workflow_policy_json IS NOT NULL OR workflow_policy_hash IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]==0
for table in ['hosted_reconciliations','hosted_operations','hosted_operation_locks']:
 assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM "+table).fetchone()[0]==0
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM deployment_intents WHERE delivery_stage != 'legacy'").fetchone()[0]==0
assert changed.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM gitops_change_sets g JOIN deployment_intents d ON d.id=g.deployment_intent_id WHERE d.delivery_stage != 'legacy'").fetchone()[0]==0
print(json.dumps({"schema_version":"pharness.dev/live-copy-migration-evidence/v1alpha1","integrity":"ok","foreign_key_violations":0,"maximum_migration":54,"applied_migrations":len(versions),"source_migration_unchanged":original.execute("SELECT max(version) FROM _sqlx_migrations").fetchone()[0],"archive_sha256":'sha256:1531fb59c582ded308b2cd691d9dca4f5f96b76f1ca9ff02b49692613fe5aa2d',"all_original_columns_identical":True,"preserved_tables":len(preserved),"original_column_fingerprints":preserved,"hosted_rows":0,"runtime_image":'registry.lucas.engineering/pharness-runtime@sha256:1e63d8f1c7fa34bcd390fa80747fc8705b0631e750029d62bb2a8890dffd7709',"source_revision":'19b0c55c48e3614d0b4507d56df3029a52475618',"scope":"read-only live schema-54 verification before qualification"}))
